items.headline: Jacobs opens the season on the exempt list; Lloyd is the Week 1 lead back
items.summary: Jacobs stays on the Commissioner's Exempt List until Goodell removes him, with no timeline and a first court date on 17 November. Green Bay's available backfield is MarShawn Lloyd, Chris Brooks and Kaleb Johnson, with Lloyd the clear favourite for Week 1 touches against Minnesota.

sources.title: NFL places Packers RB Josh Jacobs on Commissioner's Exempt List
Packers RB's uncertain fantasy outlook with recent Josh Jacobs news

items.headline: Thirty players serve Week 1 suspensions; Jeshaun Jones the only fantasy-relevant one
items.summary: SI's list of players suspended to start 2026 has 30 names (plus nine free agents). Among skill players, only Vikings WR Jeshaun Jones (3 games, substances of abuse) matters for fantasy; the rest are defenders such as Falcons edge James Pearce Jr. (8 games) and Commanders edge Dorance Armstrong (1).

sources.title: Every player suspended to start the 2026 NFL season
Full list of Week 1 NFL suspensions

items.headline: Keenan Allen will play Week 1 after his arrest; a three-game suspension can still come later
items.summary: Colts GM Chris Ballard said Allen will be in the lineup against Baltimore and any discipline is in-house. The league's first-offence alcohol policy is a three-game ban, but the NFL normally waits for the legal case; his court date is 16 September. Draft him knowing a midseason suspension is a live possibility.

sources.title: Colts expect WR Keenan Allen to play in season opener
Will Keenan Allen be suspended or cut?

items.headline: Charbonnet on reserve/PUP; rookie Jadarian Price leads Seattle's backfield from Week 1
items.summary: Charbonnet misses at least four games recovering from the knee. The Seahawks plan to let first-round rookie Price lead the run game against New England despite zero preseason snaps, with George Holani expected to get a heavy dose behind him. When Charbonnet returns the split is expected to be close to even.

sources.title: Seahawks plan to let rookie RB Jadarian Price lead their backfield
SEA backfield to have 'heavy dose' of Holani
Are the Seahawks ready for rookie Jadarian Price to lead run game?

items.headline: Love's high-ankle sprain leaves Week 1 about 50/50; still the consensus 1.01 rookie
items.summary: No surgery, and head coach Mike LaFleur says he keeps taking steps, but he would not commit to the 13 September opener against the Chargers. Schefter's four-week healing estimate lands right on the opener. Yahoo and PFN still rank him the top rookie for redraft.

sources.title: Jeremiyah Love injury update provided by Cardinals HC
Could Jeremiyah Love miss Week 1?

items.headline: Jeanty back on the field with trainers; Raiders counting on him for Week 1
items.summary: First time on the practice field since the 23 August ankle sprain, working to the side on 1 September. Klint Kubiak: still on the mend, another week to assess, but the team is counting on him against Miami. Not yet a full participant.

sources.title: Ashton Jeanty injury update from Raiders practice brings more optimism for Week 1

items.headline: Chase (knee) and Higgins (heel) limited all week; Bengals expect both for Week 1
items.summary: Chase hyperextended his left knee going up for a Burrow pass on 25 August and Higgins has a heel issue. Zac Taylor announced both will be limited throughout the week but said he feels good about them for Tampa Bay on 13 September and that both will be good by the end of the week.

Ja'Marr Chase will be limited at practice after injury

items.headline: Nabers practising without the non-contact jersey; 'reasonable' to expect him Week 1
items.summary: Back from the torn ACL, he practised on 31 August without the red jersey and John Harbaugh called Week 1 a reasonable assumption. Nabers himself has not committed and has not done full-contact team periods: no target date, stacking days.

sources.title: Malik Nabers injury status: Giants WR shares honest assessment

items.headline: Kittle pushing to play the Melbourne opener; Pearsall out for the year, Kirk on IR
items.summary: Kittle (Achilles) is expected to practise this week and is listed questionable for the 10 September opener against the Rams in Australia. Pearsall is done for the season after PCL surgery and Kirk opened on IR, which is why second-round rookie De'Zhaun Stribling is the depth piece to watch behind Demarcus Robinson and Deebo Samuel.

items.headline: Warren back at practice and expected for Week 1; Pierce off PUP with Week 1 'the goal'
items.summary: Warren strained an adductor on 19 August and practised on 1 September; Rapoport says no reason for concern. Pierce was activated from active/PUP on 27 August and both he and GM Ballard call Week 1 the goal, not a certainty.

sources.title: Colts receive Tyler Warren update from insider
Colts No. 1 WR Pierce off PUP list

items.headline: Monangai still week-to-week with the hyperextended knee; Swift carries Chicago early
items.summary: The 17 August hyperextension was expected to cost multiple weeks and Ben Johnson still calls him week-to-week. Swift is primed for a big workload against Carolina in Week 1 until Monangai is back.

sources.title: Report: Bears RB Kyle Monangai will miss weeks with a hyperextended knee

items.headline: Sadiq on track for Week 1 but ramping up; Mason Taylor is the every-down tight end for now
items.summary: The first-round rookie missed most of camp and all of the preseason after a hernia-surgery setback. Aaron Glenn says he remains on track for the Titans, but he will not have an every-down role out of the gate.

sources.title: Jets' Kenyon Sadiq: optimism for Week 1 status

items.headline: Both Washington backs banged up; rookie Kaytron Allen could see more than a third-back role
items.summary: Croskey-Merritt (lower body) is set to lead early downs and White (hamstring) the receiving work, but both missed time and the team can manage them carefully. Sixth-rounder Kaytron Allen is the physical option behind them and the one who benefits if either lingers.

items.headline: Musgrave (neck) opens on reserve/PUP: out at least four games
items.summary: Placed on the PUP list at the roster cutdown; GM Gutekunst expects him to play in 2026 but not before Week 5.

sources.title: Packers place TE Luke Musgrave on PUP list, pare roster to 53

items.headline: Dobbins' camp soft-tissue injury called minor; Denver is a three-man rotation with rookie Coleman
items.summary: Payton said Dobbins is 'gonna be fine' and the team is being smart with him for Week 1 against Kansas City. Dobbins is the early-down favourite, Harvey the passing-down back, and third-round rookie Jonah Coleman has forced his way into a short-yardage and goal-line role rather than a Week 1 lineup lock.

sources.title: Payton: Dobbins exited with soft-tissue injury
Jonah Coleman fantasy outlook 2026

items.headline: Tyreek Hill will not sign before the season; midseason at best
items.summary: Released by Miami in February after the knee dislocation and multiple ligament tears, Hill's agent says he will take his time to pick the right team and no deal is expected before Week 1. Earlier reporting put a return around midseason. He should not be drafted as a Week 1 asset.

sources.title: Tyreek Hill's agent sheds light on timeline

items.headline: Carnell Tate steps in as Tennessee's WR1 from Week 1
items.summary: The fourth overall pick is expected to be Cam Ward's top downfield weapon against the Jets, alongside slot man Wan'Dale Robinson, with Elic Ayomanor the other outside option. Of the seven first-40 rookie receivers, he has the clearest path to being his team's No. 1 target.

items.headline: Makai Lemon opens as Philadelphia's No. 3 receiver, in the slot
items.summary: First-round talent, but a camp hamstring strain, a crowded room and a low-volume passing game cap the rookie: he is ticketed for the slot with Smith wide and Wicks opposite, a rotational role with week-to-week viability rather than a starter's floor.

sources.title: Updated Makai Lemon fantasy outlook 2026
Makai Lemon tops 4 rookies with sinking fantasy value

items.headline: Browns say both rookie receivers will play a lot; Boston moved into the first-team offense
items.summary: Todd Monken said Concepcion and Boston are going to play a lot as rookies, and Boston, listed as the No. 1 receiver on the early depth chart, was moved into the first-team offense after a standout camp. Concepcion has the first-round capital but the lower Week 1 slot of the two.

sources.title: Boston listed as No. 1 WR on early depth chart
Updated KC Concepcion fantasy outlook 2026

items.headline: Omar Cooper Jr. settles in as the Jets' WR3 behind Wilson and Mitchell
items.summary: Fans assumed the 30th pick would be the WR2, but Adonai Mitchell's emergence pushed Cooper into a battle with Isaiah Williams for the third spot, which he won with a string of solid practices. Frank Reich plans to move him between slot and outside.

items.headline: Third-rounder Caleb Douglas wins a starting job in Miami; Chris Bell back from the ACL on a snap count
items.summary: Douglas beat out veterans for a starting spot alongside Washington and Tolbert and is already a go-to target for Malik Willis. Bell expects to play Week 1 after the ACL but is likely on a snap count and not a fantasy option out of the gate.

items.headline: Ja'Kobi Lane is Baltimore's WR3 in 11 personnel and pushing Bateman for the No. 2 job
items.summary: The third-round pick was a starter in three-receiver sets within the first week of camp and head coach Jesse Minter says the team will use him in the red zone. He is the beat's biggest camp winner.

items.headline: Branch competing for the Falcons' slot; Zaccheaus still taking most first-team snaps
items.summary: Atlanta plans to play the explosive rookie all over the field, with the slot his quickest path, but Zaccheaus holds the first-team reps and Branch needs designed touches to be more than a PPR spot starter. Closing-rounds target, not a starter.

items.headline: Kenneth Walker named the Chiefs' starter; fifth-round rookie Emmett Johnson the preseason standout behind him
items.summary: Walker is the lead back with Demercado listed second, but Johnson led the backfield in the preseason (84 yards on 19 carries plus four catches). Walker's ankle swelling was blamed on his shoe and he is expected for Week 1; if he sat, Johnson would be the name.

items.headline: Singleton opens behind Pollard and Spears in Tennessee
items.summary: Pollard starts and Spears is the likely backup; the Penn State rookie begins as the third or fourth back with paths to early-down relief or passing-down touches, and more in 2027 with both veterans in contract years. Not a 2026 draft priority.

items.headline: Raridon behind Hunter Henry in two-TE sets; streaming option only if Henry misses time
items.summary: Athletic, reliable hands, high praise out of Patriots camp, but the rookie opens as the No. 2 tight end and is not a Week 1 fantasy option.

items.headline: Stowers is the heir to Goedert, not the starter: two-TE sets in 2026
items.summary: Goedert is on a one-year deal and Stowers will share the field with him, but he has no clear No. 1 role and needs to improve as a run blocker to see more snaps.

items.headline: No rookie quarterback starts Week 1: Cousins over Mendoza, Simpson behind Stafford, Beck behind in Arizona
items.summary: The Raiders named Kirk Cousins the Week 1 starter over the No. 1 overall pick, making Mendoza the first top pick since Baker Mayfield not to start the opener. Rams first-rounder Ty Simpson is locked in behind Stafford and Carson Beck is a long shot to start for Arizona. For the first time since 2022 Week 1 opens with zero rookie quarterbacks.

items.headline: Cowboys cut Jaydon Blue; Malik Davis is the handcuff, Phil Mafah behind him
items.summary: Blue did not make Dallas's 53 at the 30 August cutdown. The plan is Malik Davis as the handcuff with Mafah next; Blue is on waivers with other recognisable names such as Dameon Pierce, Frank Gore Jr., Will Levis and Mecole Hardman.

items.headline: Lions release Greg Dortch and Tyler Conklin at the cutdown
items.summary: Dortch had four weekly WR1 finishes in his Cardinals years and Conklin averaged 553 receiving yards a season from 2021 to 2024; both are free agents after Detroit's cuts.

items.headline: Higgins out for the season (ACL) and Dell on IR: Houston's targets consolidate around Collins
items.summary: Higgins tore his ACL in August and was expected to start opposite Nico Collins; Dell opened the season on injured reserve. Both confirmed by the team.

items.summary: The first-round receiver misses at least the first four games on injured reserve. Undrafted rookie Brock Rechsteiner is suspended for six games under the PED policy. Neither is a Week 1 asset.
